WITH large_orders AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, o.amount
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE o.amount >= 2802
),
group_avgs AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM large_orders
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM group_avgs
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference
FROM group_avgs g
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
